user.description: Shoebox manages the pictures in your media folders: folders, upload, rotate and crop, and rotating pictures for dashboards and displays.

data_description.folders: The media folders Shoebox works on. "local" is My media; more come from media_dirs in configuration.yaml. Paths in Shoebox start with the folder's name, such as local/Family/beach.jpg.

error.no_folder: Choose at least one media folder.

user.title: Rotation
user.description: A rotation shows the pictures its patterns select, one at a time: in path order, or shuffled with every picture once per round.

data_description.name: Shown as the rotation's device and entity name.
data_description.patterns: Globs over paths, which start with the media folder's name ("*" within a folder, "**" at any depth), or "re:" followed by a regular expression. The rotation shows the pictures of all patterns together; a pattern starting with "!" leaves pictures out, such as !**/private/**.
data_description.order: Path order shows the pictures sorted by path. Shuffle shows each picture once per round, in random order.

error.slow_patterns: These patterns take more than a second to match the pictures; simplify them (fewer "**", simpler re: expressions).

init.description: Shoebox keeps pictures prepared at the sizes dashboards and devices ask for. The cache now holds {files} pictures ({size} MB).

data_description.folders: The media folders Shoebox works on. "local" is My media; more come from media_dirs in configuration.yaml. Paths in Shoebox start with the folder's name, such as local/Family/beach.jpg.
data_description.cache_size: When the cache grows past this, the pictures used least recently are removed. 0 turns the cache off: pictures are prepared on every request.
data_description.clear_cache: Removes every prepared picture. They are made again when needed.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: The Shoebox panel for administrators. Actions, entities and device pictures work either way.

error.no_folder: Choose at least one media folder.

list.name: List media
list.description: Lists the files and folders in the chosen media folders that match a pattern.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: A glob over paths that start with the media folder's name ("*" within a folder, "**" at any depth, "?", "[...]"), for example "local/Family/**"; or "re:" followed by a regular expression.

type.name: Type
type.description: Only pictures, other files or folders.

create_folder.name: Create folder
create_folder.description: Creates a folder in a media folder, with any missing parent folders.

path.name: Path
path.description: The new folder, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/2025 Summer".

move.name: Move
move.description: Moves a file or folder into another folder. Nothing is overwritten.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/beach.jpg".

to.name: To
to.description: The folder to move into, for example "local/Family", or a media folder itself such as "local". It may be in another media folder.

rename.name: Rename
rename.description: Renames a file or folder in place. Nothing is overwritten.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/beach.jpg".

name.name: New name
name.description: The new name, without a folder.

delete.name: Delete
delete.description: Deletes a file, or a folder with everything in it. This cannot be undone.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/beach.jpg".

rotate.name: Rotate picture
rotate.description: Turns a JPEG picture by changing its EXIF orientation; the picture data is not re-encoded.

path.name: Path
path.description: Picture, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/beach.jpg".

by.name: By
by.description: How far to turn the picture as shown, clockwise.

orientation.name: Orientation
orientation.description: Sets the EXIF orientation (1 to 8) instead of turning.

crop.name: Crop picture
crop.description: Crops a JPEG picture by storing the crop in its XMP data, as photo editors do; the picture data is not changed.

path.name: Path
path.description: Picture, starting with the media folder's name, for example "local/Family/beach.jpg".

left.name: Left
left.description: The left edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

top.name: Top
top.description: The top edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

right.name: Right
right.description: The right edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

bottom.name: Bottom
bottom.description: The bottom edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

metadata_too_large.message: The metadata segment is too large.
